title: MOF-assisted cryo-adsorption delivers near-liquid volumetric capacity and suppressed boil-off for LH₂ transport
innovation: We introduce a materials-based solution using metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) to suppress boil-off by enhancing gas–surface interactions and stabilizing confined hydrogen.
limitations: Screening conclusions may depend on idealized structures, force fields, and missing defects/flexibility.

title: Recent advances in the strategies of developing water-resistant catalysts for the removal of atmospheric pollutants
innovation: In the catalytic oxidation of atmospheric pollutants such as volatile organic compounds (VOCs), catalyst deactivation induced by water under realistic operating conditions has emerged as a critical bottleneck constraining the large-scale application of this technology.
limitations: Descriptor transfer depends on whether the proposed active-site model remains physically faithful in MOF node or defect environments.
next_steps: Test whether active-site descriptors transfer to MOF nodes, defects, bimetallic sites, or local-field-controlled catalytic regimes. Test humid or multicomponent conditions and connect material metrics to process-level targets.
mof_relevance: Already in the MOF literature; keep it only if the method adds a new representation, label space, or uncertainty/active-learning angle.
